title: queue file
description: The tasks that the user stacks together, and the hour they start, as the user writes them in <queue>.json.

start.description: The hour the queue's first tasks start, as HH:MM on the computer's clock. Without it, they start at once.

tasks.description: Each task, in the order the tasks start.

name.description: The task's name, once in the queue, which names its reply file.

prompt.description: The path of the file that holds the task's prompt, from the queue file's folder.

dir.description: The absolute path of the folder the task works in.

writes.description: true where the task may write in its dir; otherwise it gets only the tools that read.
